en.headline: Lawmakers pass thanks motion on five-year plan and policy address
en.dek: After three days of debate, the Legislative Council passed the thanks motion on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address.
body: The Legislative Council passed the thanks motion on Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address on Friday evening, after three days of combined debate, RTHK reported.

Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki, summing up, said the plan set out a systematic arrangement for economic and social development over the next five years, and that Hong Kong's path had to be planned within the country's wider development. He pointed to innovation and technology, new industrialisation, emerging industries and faster work on the Northern Metropolis as areas the government intended to press.

Chan said the plan and the Policy Address also covered housing, healthcare, education, elderly care, youth, labour protection and support for disadvantaged groups. He said security was a condition of development, and that the government would keep refining the legal system and enforcement mechanisms for safeguarding national security.
Earlier on Friday, Chief Executive John Lee thanked lawmakers for raising different views and said the government would make sure the measures were carried out, according to RTHK.

zh.headline: 立法會通過五年規劃及施政報告致謝議案
zh.dek: 立法會經過一連三日辯論，周五晚上通過香港第一個五年規劃及施政報告的致謝議案。
body: 港台報道，立法會經過一連三日合併辯論，周五晚上通過《香港第一個五年規劃》及《施政報告》的致謝議案。
政務司司長陳國基總結時表示，五年規劃是對未來五年經濟和社會發展作出系統部署，香港發展必須放在國家發展大局中謀劃。他提到要把握創科、新型工業化、新興產業及未來產業的機遇，並加速北部都會區建設，以北都作為高等教育和創科的主要增長引擎。
陳國基又說，五年規劃和施政報告涵蓋房屋、醫療、教育、安老、青年、勞工保障和弱勢社群支援。他指出安全是發展的前提，特區會持續完善維護國家安全的法律制度和執行機制。
港台另引述行政長官李家超表示，感謝議員提出不同意見，政府會確保施政落到實處。
